summary: Parses a 'View' element from a scene-file token stream: reads optional attributes (view/recursion, color, clipplanes, orient, dir, size, center, clear, bgmap, separatesurfac), then configures a view object (angles, projection, clip planes, color, orientation matrix or direction translation, clear/bgmap flags) and tail-inserts it into the owning scene list. Returns 0 on success, -1 on parse or allocation failure.

local_names.a3: optional owner list to tail-insert the view

operations.description: Parse the View element opening from the token stream via sub_544E90; return -1 on failure.
Initialize parse state: counters cleared to 0, three fields defaulted to 72, and the clear-mode flag initialized to 32.
Read the first token via LineReaderFromBuffer; when it is not the final token (value 1), enter the attribute token loop.
While the token stream head is not the end-of-stream marker (3), keep consuming attribute tokens; break early when LineReaderFromBuffer returns 1.
Skip the structured-token block when the current token is the delimiter value 2.
Match the token against the 'view' string (aView) via sub_559E20; on match recurse into sub_55A060 for a nested view and return -1 if it fails.
Read a float quartet seeded from off_5DC230 (last value unused) and a float pair seeded from off_5C57FC.
Read the color triple via sub_559F00 using the 'color' token.
Read the clip-planes pair via the 'clipplanes' token.
Read the orientation triple via the 'orient' token; when present set the orientation-mode flag to 1.
Read the direction triple via the 'dir' token; when present set the orientation-mode flag to 2.
Read the size pair via the 'size' token; scale entries that are at most 1.0 by the screen-width global dword_8B8DD4 and screen-height global dword_8B8DD8.
Read the center pair via the 'center' token; scale entries that are at most 1.0 by dword_8B8DD4 and dword_8B8DD8.
Match the 'clear' token via sub_559E20; when found, set or clear bit 1 of the clear-mode flag depending on whether the read string equals 'true'.
Match the 'bgmap' token via sub_559E20; set the bgmap-present flag to 1 when found.
Match the 'separatesurfac' token via sub_559E20 (result value not retained).
After the loop, if a bgmap was requested allocate the background-map surface on the parsed object (+104 words) via MemoryAllocation_cb20; return -1 on failure.
Convert the two parsed angle values to radians (multiply by 0.01745433) and set the view orientation via sub_542050.
Compute the view center (center minus half of size) and configure the projection via sub_542200.
Set the clip-plane pair on the view object via TwoFieldSetterCall.
Pack the color into the view object via ColorPack.
Store the accumulated clear-mode flag into the view object's flag word.

When direction mode was selected, negate the direction triple, update the orientation rotation matrix via OrientationRotationMatrixUpdate, and translate the camera by the negated direction via sub_541F60.
Otherwise feed the orientation triple into UtilityFunction_1cd0.
Tail-insert the constructed view object: LinkedListInsertTail into the provided owner list a3 when non-null, else DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion into the current object.
Return 0 on success.

clean_pseudocode: if (match(a4, aView, name) && sub_55A060(name, view, a4)) return -1;
configure angles, projection, clip planes, color, orientation/direction;
if (a3) LinkedListInsertTail(a3, view); else DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion(this, view);
